title: requires Basics
concept: The `requires` clause declares what must be true when a function is called — the caller's responsibility.
why: requires catches invalid inputs at the call site instead of letting bad data propagate through your program undetected.
tips: Use requires to validate ALL external inputs at function boundaries
Chain multiple requires from most fundamental to most specific
A function with requires documents the contract in code — no need for comments
Think of requires as the guard at the castle gate
common_mistakes: Forgetting that multiple requires are all checked — one failure still traps
Writing requires: balance > amount but the code never actually uses amount
Using side-effecting functions inside requires — the compiler will reject this
